name: crowdsec-web-ui
description: CrowdSec Web UI, a self-hosted dashboard for CrowdSec: investigate alerts, manage decisions, monitor runtime metrics, and send notifications from one responsive UI. The UI connects to the CrowdSec Local API (LAPI) as a watcher machine. Register it on your CrowdSec container before starting this one, using a strong password (e.g. from openssl rand -hex 32): docker exec crowdsec cscli machines add crowdsec-web-ui --password 'your-password' -f /dev/null Keep -f /dev/null so the CrowdSec container's own credentials file is not overwritten. Set the LAPI URL to an address reachable from this container: http://crowdsec:8080 when both containers share a custom Docker network, or http:// :8080 otherwise. On first visit, create the initial administrator account. Alert deletion additionally requires this container's IP or Docker network CIDR to be listed under api.server.trusted_ips in CrowdSec's config.yaml; without it, deletes fail with 403 Forbidden. A config.yaml with all advanced options (OIDC, notifications, multiple instances, sync settings) is generated in the data directory on first start. https://github.com/TheDuffman85/crowdsec-web-ui

paths.name: Data
paths.description: SQLite database, alert history cache, and the generated config.yaml.

ports.name: Container Port 1
ports.description: CrowdSec Web UI (HTTP). Use a reverse proxy for HTTPS; passkeys require HTTPS.

variables.name: CONFIG_INSTANCE_LAPI_URL
variables.description: CrowdSec LAPI base URL (no path), e.g. http://crowdsec:8080 on a shared custom network or http:// :8080.

variables.name: CONFIG_INSTANCE_LAPI_AUTH_USERNAME
variables.description: Machine name registered on CrowdSec via cscli machines add.

variables.name: CONFIG_INSTANCE_LAPI_AUTH_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password used when registering the machine with cscli machines add.

variables.name: CONFIG_INSTANCE_NAME
variables.description: Optional display name for this CrowdSec instance. Defaults to Instance 0.

variables.name: CONFIG_INSTANCE_METRICS_URL
variables.description: Optional CrowdSec Prometheus endpoint for the Metrics page, e.g. http://crowdsec:6060/metrics. CrowdSec must listen on 0.0.0.0 with prometheus level: full.

variables.name: CONFIG_SERVER_BASE_PATH
variables.description: Optional URL prefix when served under a reverse proxy subpath, e.g. /crowdsec (no trailing slash).

variables.name: CONFIG_UI_TIME_ZONE
variables.description: Timezone for displayed dates: browser, or an IANA zone such as America/New_York or UTC.

variables.name: CONFIG_UI_READ_ONLY
variables.description: Set to true to hide management actions and reject all write operations for every user.
